data.title: Bitcoin falls below $82,000 as $120 million in crypto longs get liquidated
data.description: Bitcoin slipped below $82,000, and leveraged bulls paid for it almost immediately. Roughly $120 million in long positions across crypto were liquidated in the span of 15 minutes.The drop pushed Bitcoin under the $82,000 mark during intraday trading on October 12.
